romance.th: โรแมนติกดราม่า
romance.instruction: Stage the changing distance between the characters, their eyelines and the silence after an important line.

comedy.th: คอเมดี้ / ฟีลกู๊ด
comedy.instruction: Set up an expectation in the frame, time its reversal and hold for the listener's reaction.

drama.th: ดราม่าครอบครัว / ชีวิต
drama.instruction: Reveal relationships through seating, routines, shared objects and what remains unsaid.

thriller.th: สืบสวน / ระทึกขวัญ
thriller.instruction: Sequence visible clues, control what is outside the frame and distinguish what the audience knows from what the characters know.

adventure.th: แอ็กชัน / ผจญภัย
adventure.instruction: Establish geography, screen direction, distance to the obstacle and an action match for the cut.

horror.th: สยองขวัญ / ลึกลับ
horror.instruction: Use negative space, an identifiable source of sound and a deliberate delay before the reveal.

fantasy.th: แฟนตาซี / เหนือธรรมชาติ
fantasy.instruction: Establish a rule of the world through its visible physical effect and maintain it across shots.
